questions.question_english: Under the RTI Act, what is the consequence if a PIO fails to provide information within the statutory 30-day limit without valid cause?
options_english: Automatic cancellation and rejection of the applicant’s request
Refund of full income tax liabilities to the RTI applicant
Immediate administrative closing of the case permanently

questions.question_english: In e-Procurement, what is a “Two-Bid System”?
options_english: Bidding twice for the same contract on two consecutive working days
Restricting procurement by allowing only two qualified contractors to submit bids
Inviting technical and financial bids in separate sealed digital covers
Submitting one bid for capital goods supply and one separate bid for land acquisition
questions.explanation_english: A Two-Bid System in electronic procurement requires participating vendors to submit technical proposals and financial offers in two separate, encrypted digital covers simultaneously. The technical bids are opened and evaluated first to determine vendor eligibility and specification compliance. Financial bids of only technically qualified bidders are subsequently unlocked, ensuring that commercial offers do not influence technical evaluations during tender processing.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। ई-प्रोक्योरमेंट में दो-निविदा प्रणाली में भाग लेने वाले विक्रेताओं को तकनीकी प्रस्ताव और वित्तीय प्रस्ताव दो अलग-अलग, एन्क्रिप्टेड डिजिटल कवर में एक साथ प्रस्तुत करने की आवश्यकता होती है। तकनीकी निविदाएँ पहले खोली जाती हैं और विक्रेता की पात्रता और विनिर्देशन अनुपालन निर्धारित करने के लिए मूल्यांकित की जाती हैं। केवल तकनीकी रूप से योग्य निविदाकर्ताओं की वित्तीय निविदाएँ बाद में खोली जाती हैं, यह सुनिश्चित करते हुए कि व्यावसायिक प्रस्ताव निविदा प्रक्रिया के दौरान तकनीकी मूल्यांकन को प्रभावित नहीं करते हैं।
questions.topic: Government E-Procurement, Grievance, and Administrative Portals
key_facts: A Two-Bid System separates technical and financial bids.
Printed answer key: (C) Inviting technical and financial bids in separate sealed digital covers.
